results.title: Glenbrackie Coastal Path | Walk Highlands Guide
results.text: The Glenbrackie Coastal Path runs 12 miles from the harbour to Ardnish Point, one way. Allow 5 to 6 hours. The first 3 miles follow a level track; after that the path climbs over the cliffs. The bus back leaves from Ardnish, 2 miles inland.
